role: Upstream data-integrity gate. No new ecological model may be fit to the later census version until this audit is resolved.
known_before_freeze: The repository has used Palmer LTER AdeliePenguinCensus DOI 10.6073/pasta/89dd52217ca37e3a72a67f7a9bc3c82e with pinned CSV SHA256 b4ef04e2275ea779fc8fe54fa13528dc2052d37dd88a60c811d54c7601f67b16.
That pinned extract contains 1,489 parsed colony-year rows and ends in 2017.
For Torgersen in 1993 the pinned extract sums to 2,868 breeding pairs.

Patterson historical tables contain colony numbers whose overlapping counts match the pinned extract, while several major Torgersen colony numbers (including 7-11 and 16) are absent from the pinned extract.
Cimino et al. 2025 cites a later Palmer census version, DOI 10.6073/pasta/805f6b97593c60cfdfd02266db9ab4b6, described as 1991-2021 ver. 8, and reports a 1993 Torgersen total of 7,255 breeding pairs.
These discrepancies have already been observed; this audit is not outcome-blind.
primary_question: Is the pinned 89dd census extract equivalent to, a documented subset of, or incomplete relative to the later 805f ver.8 area-wide census?

later.description_from_2025_citation: Adelie penguin area-wide breeding population census, 1991-2021 ver 8

audit_steps: Recover public metadata and, if possible, raw bytes for the later ver.8 census without using ecological outcome results to select files.
Compare metadata: package/version, date coverage, field definitions, entity/file identity, revision notes, and stated scope.
Compare row keys on island + raw colony_code + census year.
For keys present in both, report exact count equality, disagreements, and duplicate structure.
Report keys present only in old and only in later versions by island, colony_code, and year.
Compare island-year totals for all overlapping years without fitting ecological models.
Explicitly audit Torgersen 1993 against the published 7,255-pair reference and historical colony tables.
Determine whether omissions in the old extract are systematic by colony_code and whether missing colonies contribute substantial abundance.
Do not compute concentration slopes, lag coefficients, synchrony, extinction hazard, or any other ecological outcome on ver.8 during this audit.

decision_classes.equivalent: The old pinned extract and ver.8 differ only by later years/metadata or immaterial transport formatting; all overlapping biological row keys and counts are equivalent.
decision_classes.documented_subset: The old extract intentionally represents a documented subset with an explicit source definition that explains omitted colonies; prior results remain valid only for that subset and must be relabeled accordingly.
decision_classes.incomplete_relative_to_intended_area_wid: The old extract omits biological rows/colonies from the intended area-wide census without an explicit subset definition; any prior analysis claiming whole-island totals, colony concentration, or complete colony panels requires frozen-specification rerun on ver.8 before ecological use.
decision_classes.unresolved: Ver.8 raw data or sufficient metadata cannot be publicly recovered to distinguish the above classes.

downstream_rules.if_equivalent: Resume the paused colony-environment audit with no Palmer population-result changes.
downstream_rules.if_documented_subset: Create a claim-boundary repair relabeling all affected Palmer results as subset analyses before any manuscript use; assess whether the subset answers each original question.
downstream_rules.if_incomplete: Freeze exact rerun contracts that clone the existing specifications before opening any rerun results on ver.8. Do not tune models, lags, exclusions, endpoints, or thresholds.
downstream_rules.if_unresolved: Do not silently treat the old extract as complete area-wide census; manuscript claims must state the unresolved source-version limitation.

claim_boundaries: Do not call prior Palmer ecological results invalid solely because a source discrepancy was detected.
Do not call the old extract a complete area-wide census unless equivalence or completeness is demonstrated.
Do not choose a census version because it yields stronger ecological results.
Do not refit ecological models during this source-integrity audit.
Do not manually add historical colony counts into either source.
Use raw colony_code strings unchanged when comparing versions.
